description: Scala source code for utility functions used in Apache Spark's Python worker integration, including serialization/deserialization, broadcast management, and accumulator updates.

methods.name: writeUTF
methods.description: Serializes a string in UTF-8 and writes it to DataOutputStream.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes a byte array to DataOutputStream with length prefix.

methods.name: writePythonVersion
methods.description: Serializes Python version string for version check.

methods.name: writeSparkFiles
methods.description: Serializes Spark files and includes for worker setup.

methods.name: writeBroadcasts
methods.description: Serializes broadcast variables and manages encrypted broadcast setup.

methods.name: readUTF
methods.description: Deserializes a UTF-8 string from DataInputStream.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array from DataInputStream.

methods.name: receiveAccumulatorUpdates
methods.description: Receives and adds accumulator updates from DataInputStream.
